name: OnTheEvening_1
short_caption: The robot opens its arms outward and then brings them back down to its sides in a gentle, welcoming gesture.
movement_description: The robot starts in a neutral posture and smoothly raises both arms outward and slightly forward, with its hands open and palms facing inward. After reaching a moderate height at around one second, it begins to lower its arms back down to its sides. By the four-second mark, the robot has fully returned to its resting neutral position.
safety_notes: The robot sweeps its arms outward to the sides, requiring clear space of about half a meter on both the left and right sides of its torso.
